name: zvideo_dd3d_update_fog_color
description: zVideo_dd3d::UpdateFogColor uploads the applied fog RGB floats as a packed Direct3D fog color render state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo DD3D fog/device-state pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4aab30 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, cdecl no-argument/no-return ABI, and a single Direct3D provider SetRenderState call through vtable slot 0x5c.
The function packs g_zVideo_FogColorAppliedR255/G255/B255 into 0xRRGGBB after +0.5 rounding through _ftol, then calls D3DRENDERSTATE_FOGCOLOR with the packed value.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4aab30 has no warning tags. The only direct callee is _ftol, classified as compiler-generated glue provider; IDirect3DDevice2::SetRenderState is a Direct3D provider boundary.
The native smoke uses a fake IDirect3DDevice2 provider and verifies exactly one FOGCOLOR SetRenderState call, the applied RGB rounding/packing result, and no light-state calls.
